digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and subprocess runtime isolation
propositions: write/apply and subprocess paths currently rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtimes, causing unintended scope writes and credential leakage to sibling processes

Jira Cloud implicit DIG fallbacks exist in four locations (write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, create-time default) that can execute requests under unintended scope when project is unset

Child process environment inheritance lacks isolation: same-capability children inherit ambient state, owned children receive full overlay, and unrelated siblings can access other adapters' secret names
Global os.environ is mutated during operation dispatch and subprocess invocation instead of being passed as isolated scope snapshots
Current implementation has four hardcoded DIG defaults that must be eliminated so requests fail closed when project scope is unset rather than defaulting to DIG
Child environment builder must implement pure projection API with checked-in registry of secret names per adapter to enforce strict isolation across concurrent reconciler operations
